title: The ozone hole opens in spring because chlorine needs sunlight to destroy ozone
body: On 16 September 2026, Copernicus reported that this season's Antarctic ozone hole had reached 15 million km² by the end of August, slightly earlier than average, and an estimated 25 million km² on 12 September, about 5 million above the usual for the date. The hole needs several things at once, and they only come together over Antarctica. In the winter dark the polar vortex, a ring of strong winds, walls off the air, which gets colder than about −78 °C, so thin polar stratospheric clouds form; on them, chlorine from CFCs is freed from harmless compounds. When sunlight returns in spring, it drives reactions in which a single chlorine atom destroys many thousands of ozone molecules ([NOAA](https://csl.noaa.gov/assessments/ozone/2022/twentyquestions/)). This year's fast growth came with a sudden drop in temperature 20 km above the pole, while other measures stayed close to average. Chlorine is slowly falling since CFCs were phased out, and the 2022 assessment expects ozone over Antarctica back at 1980 levels [around 2066](https://wmo.int/node/20737).

slides.question: Inside the ozone hole, ozone falls to about what share of its level in early-1970s springs?
slides.explanation: About a third: near 120 Dobson units inside the hole from late September to mid-October, against about 350 in the early 1970s (NOAA).

slides.alt: Animation of Antarctica from above: the ozone hole grows from 15 to 25 million km², past the usual 20. Then a cross-section: the polar vortex, air colder than −78 °C, pearly clouds freeing chlorine, the Sun returning and ozone vanishing. Then the 2026 season, chlorine falling and 2066.

slides.prompt: Open an ozone hole over Antarctica, then find two different ways to keep it shut.
slides.takeaway: Warm the stratosphere above −78 °C, keep it dark, or cut chlorine to its 1980 level: take away any one and the hole stays shut. Only the chlorine is in our hands, and it is slowly falling.

slides.heading: How the ozone hole opens and closes

steps.label: Winter: the polar vortex walls off the air
On them, chlorine is set free
Spring sunlight sets it to work on ozone
Nov–Dec: the vortex weakens, the hole closes

slides.question: Why does the ozone hole open in spring rather than in the dark of winter?
options: The polar vortex forms in spring
Ozone is only made in winter
slides.explanation: Chlorine is freed on the cold polar clouds during winter, but the reactions that destroy ozone need sunlight, which returns to Antarctica in spring.

source.label: Copernicus (CAMS): Ozone hole reaches notable threshold early again as area increases above average in 2026
